Former Director of US Mint: Bitcoin Allows Money to Be Privatized Again

The coin chat on Freenode includes #cryptocurrency-collectors, which is a very active group of coin collectors that specialize in physical cryptocoins minted and issued by private mints. Top values reach above $3000, and potentially much, much more.

For USA coins, the Brasher doubloon has reached valuations above $10 million USD, making it one of the most valuable coins of all time. It was privately minted by a jeweler, Ephraim Brasher. What makes it so valuable is the fact it was the first known coin to be minted within the borders of the USA that had uniquely American design elements (as opposed to European artistic style or heraldry). Being privately minted, nobody ever thought they would have any significant value, so only a few survived. All the rest were presumably melted after they became worn beyond recognition in circulation.

A similar thing occurred with USA territorial coins, minted during the era when there was only privately minted coinage available in those regions. So, privately minted coinage can indeed become enormously valuable. It's difficult to predict which ones will achieve the highest values, but it appears being first or simply "without government alternatives" counts for a lot.
